# Grid font fixture

`grid_test.ttf` is an original test font generated by `make_grid_font.py` using
the Python standard library. It contains rectangles rather than artwork from an
installed font.

The `M` and `x` glyphs advance 1000 units. The private-use glyph U+E000 advances
2000 units and has separate left and right rectangles. Its two parts make
clipping distinguishable from fitting into Neovim's one- or two-cell allocation.
Tests load the checked-in font; regeneration is not needed to run them.
Typographic family/subfamily names (OpenType name IDs 16/17) are included so
the same original fixture can exercise explicit-file font selection.

U+E001 has a normal advance but ink extending to the right of it. U+E002 has a
negative left bearing. They exercise the ink overhang used by terminal icons
and italic glyphs while retaining grid-boundary clipping.
